projectDescription: A multi-language SDK and toolset for representing spreadsheet workbooks as structured JSON, with libraries for TypeScript/Node.js and Java, code generators that produce typed classes from JSON Schema, and a browser-based schema builder and data visualizer.
keyFeatures: Workbook-as-JSON data model with typed Workbook, Sheet, Table, and List entities
TypeScript/Node.js SDK (@org-quicko/sheet) with class-transformer serialization and XLSX import/export
Java SDK (in.org.quicko.sheet:core) with Jackson annotations and Apache POI XLSX support
Node.js CLI generator (@org-quicko/sheet-generator) with json-to-schema, excel-to-schema, and schema-to-objects commands
Java Maven plugin (in.org.quicko.sheet:generator) with schema-to-pojo and excel-to-json goals
Sheet Tools Next.js browser app for interactive schema building and workbook data visualization
Structured metadata support on all workbook entities
Epoch timestamp convention for date columns
publicApiSurface: Workbook (TypeScript) — getSheets, getSheet, addSheet, replaceSheet, removeSheet, length, fromXlsx, toXlsx
Sheet (TypeScript) — getBlocks, getBlock, addBlock, replaceBlock, removeBlock, length
Table (TypeScript) — getHeader, setHeader, getRows, getRow, addRow, addRows, popRow, replaceRow, removeRow, getColumns, length
List (TypeScript) — getItems, getItem, addItem, addItems, replaceItem, removeItem, length
Item (TypeScript) — getKey, getValue, getBooleanValue, getNumberValue, getStringValue, equals
SheetJsonEntityType (TypeScript enum) — WORKBOOK, SHEET, TABLE, LIST
Workbook (Java) — getSheets, getSheet, addSheet, addSheets, replaceSheet, removeSheet, size
Sheet (Java) — getBlocks, getBlock, addBlock, replaceBlock, removeBlock, size
Table (Java) — getHeader, setHeader, getRows, getRow, addRow, addRows, popRow, replaceRow, removeRow, getColumns, size
List (Java) — getItems, getItem, addItem, addItems, replaceItem, removeItem, size
